We’ve grown very fast and are determined to keep doing so. What brought us here is our desire for continuous evolution and practical results. More than 6000 colleagues are part of eMAG Teams . We strongly believe in people's development and therefore every year we invest more and more energy and resources to remain an organization that is constantly learning. We want to ensure that you’ll have the most talented colleagues and the proper environment to grow and achieve great results, to become what you desire on a personal and professional level. Join us, grow faster ! IT Support Team Leader (Cybersecurity & IT Infrastructure Team) The IT Support Team Lead coordinates the IT support team, improves work processes, and is responsible for the administrative infrastructure (inventory, KPIs, and reporting), while also being involved in company-wide projects with significant business impact. What you’ll have to do: Processes & Automation Develop and improve the team's work processes, including automations that reduce repetitive tasks. Optimize the support workflow (intake, routing, escalation, closure). Build effective collaborative relationships with other departments. Ensure the asset inventory process (laptops, monitors, etc.) and the accuracy of data in the inventory management tool. Team Development Identify the growth potential of team members and build development plans for each of them. Propose and organize training sessions and knowledge-sharing activities for the support team, based on identified development needs and newly introduced technologies or processes. KPIs & Monitoring Define KPIs together with the direct manager. Monitor the task dashboard and the KPI list on a daily basis. Review tickets and support responses weekly to ensure service quality and consistency. Identify, based on observed situations and/or together with the team, the most effective ways to address and resolve tasks and tickets. Create the reports and tools required for monitoring and review them periodically according to team and business needs. Administrative Area Coordinate the team's administrative activities (reporting, inventory records, process documentation). Operations & Projects Review requests received through support channels and provide assistance according to their criticality and complexity. Ensure that established objectives and projects are delivered by each team member in line with agreed priorities and standards. Actively contribute to projects with significant company-wide impact (e.g. BitLocker implementation, mailbox migrations). What makes you a good fit: Minimum 4-5 years of experience in IT Support / Service Desk, including at least 1-2 years in a similar role such as Team Lead, Senior Support, or informal team coordination. Experience managing ticket flows and SLAs in a high-volume support environment (preferably e-commerce or complex organizations). Experience defining and monitoring support KPIs. Participation in large-scale IT projects (e.g. security rollouts, email migrations). Higher education degree, preferably in IT or related fields (or equivalent through relevant experience). JIRA / JIRA Service Management: dashboards, filters, reports, worklogs. End-user administration: Windows, macOS, Microsoft 365 / Exchange, Active Directory / Entra ID. Endpoint security: knowledge of BitLocker, MDM solutions, and device policies. Automation and scripting (PowerShell or similar) is an advantage. Asset inventory and fixed asset management tools. Reporting and data analysis (Excel / BI). ITIL certifications are an advantage. Good level of English, written and spoken. What makes you stand out: Leadership and motivation: inspires trust, sets direction, and maintains team engagement, including in high-pressure situations. Clear communication: explains technical topics in a simple way and adapts the message according to the audience (team, management, other departments). Feedback and mentoring: provides regular feedback and improvement recommendations tailored to each team member and develops people through mentoring. Delegation and accountability: distributes tasks according to each team member's competencies and areas of expertise and follows up on results. Customer orientation: focuses on the quality of services and support provided, consistently considering the internal customer/internal user experience. Analytical thinking and results orientation: interprets KPI data, identifies root causes, and takes corrective action while focusing on the best possible outcome. Collaboration and influence: builds strong relationships with other departments and stakeholders, maintaining a strong partnership and collaboration mindset. Initiative and continuous improvement mindset: proposes automations and process improvements by proactively identifying opportunities or implementing broader organizational directions. Can-do mindset and proactivity: approaches a wide variety of situations with initiative and provides fast and effective solutions. Working Schedule & Conditions Standard working schedule of 8 hours per day. Participation in the 24x7 On-Call rotation together with the team. Availability for projects with company-wide impact, including outside regular working hours when required. What we’ve prepared for you: Medical subscription: Medicover or Regina Maria. A flexible budget that you can invest in yourself as you wish: meal tickets, holiday tickets, cultural vouchers, private pension, foreign language classes, eMAG, Fashion Days, Therme & Genius, membership to different gyms or even professional development classes. Different discounts from our partners: banking, mobile, dental medicine or wellness. Access to the Bookster library and free credits on the Hilio psycho-emotional health platform. An accelerated learning environment, with access to over 100.000 curated online resources and platforms, learning academies and development programs. New headquarters, where sleek design, natural light, and versatile spaces create an energizing and comfortable environment for hybrid work. #midsenior Curious to find out more about the next step in your career? Apply now and if your experience is relevant for the role you wish, we will give you a call for more details! Also, here you can find our confidentiality policy if you want to consult it.

review_candidates.title: IT-Systemadministrator:in / Fachinformatiker Systemintegration Infrastruktur (m/w/d)
review_candidates.description: Gute IT ist unsere Leidenschaft! Als IT-Systemhaus finden wir bei Maaß IT nachhaltige Lösungen für unsere Kundinnen und Kunden und bieten Consulting-Leistungen aus gesamten Informationssicherheitsspektrum. Du passt zu uns, wenn IT für dich nicht nur ein Job ist und du Lust auf ein tolles Team hast! Aufgaben Bei uns arbeitest du an abwechslungsreichen IT-Infrastruktur-Themen – mal remote, mal beim Kunden vor Ort, mal im Team und mal eigenständig. Dazu gehören unter anderem: Administration von Netzwerken Implementierung und Konfiguration von Server- und PC-Lösungen Fehlerbehebung und Reparatur von Server- und Workstation-Systemen Implementierung von Firewall- und WLAN-Systemen in bestehende Netzwerke First- und Second-Level-Support technische und fachliche IT-Infrastrukturberatung Administration von Cloud-Server-Strukturen Durchführung von Infrastrukturanalysen Betreuung und Weiterentwicklung bestehender Kundenumgebungen Dokumentation von Systemen, Änderungen und Lösungen Der Schwerpunkt liegt überwiegend auf Windows-Systemen. Linux-Systeme kommen aber ebenfalls zum Einsatz, daher sind entsprechende Grundkenntnisse von Vorteil. Qualifikation Du hast eine abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Fachinformatiker für Systemintegration oder eine vergleichbare IT-Ausbildung. Wünschenswert ist Erfahrung in mehreren dieser Bereiche: Windows-Server-Umgebungen und Microsoft-Client-Systeme Active Directory, Gruppenrichtlinien, DNS, DHCP Netzwerktechnik, VLANs, Routing, Switching Firewall- und VPN-Lösungen WLAN-Infrastrukturen Virtualisierung, zum Beispiel Hyper-V oder Proxmox Microsoft 365, Azure oder andere Cloud-Dienste Backup-, Monitoring- und Sicherheitslösungen Grundkenntnisse in Linux-Systemen strukturierte Fehleranalyse und saubere Dokumentation Du musst nicht in allem Profi sein. Wichtig ist uns, dass du technische Zusammenhänge verstehst, zuverlässig arbeitest und Lust hast, dich weiterzuentwickeln. Benefits ein lockeres, kollegiales Team abwechslungsreiche Aufgaben statt eintöniger Standardarbeit moderne IT-Projekte im Infrastruktur- und Cloud-Umfeld kurze Wege und direkte Kommunikation Möglichkeiten zur Weiterbildung und persönlichen Entwicklung eigenverantwortliches Arbeiten eine langfristige Perspektive in einem wachsenden IT-Umfeld Sende uns bitte einen Lebenslauf, Qualifikationsnachweise und erkläre kurz, warum du perfekt für unser Team bist. All genders welcome!

review_candidates.title: Cloud Systems Engineer
review_candidates.description: SPEED & SPIRIT is what we look for in our candidates, defined by some simple values that inspire us to BE DRIVEN in our performance, BE VIBRANT in our sporting legacy, BE TOGETHER in our team spirit, and BE YOU to let our individual talent and experience shine. Applying for a job at PUMA is easy and all genders are welcome. Simply click APPLY ONLINE and follow the steps to upload your application. YOUR MISSION: The Engineer, Infrastructure – North America supports the day-to-day operation, stability, and continuous improvement of PUMA North America’s cloud and on-premises infrastructure platforms. This position crosses Systems Engineering and Infrastructure Engineering responsibilities, blending hands-on operational support with advanced technical troubleshooting, platform ownership, and infrastructure modernization across multiple cloud environments focusing on Microsoft Azure, Windows Server environments, virtualization (VMWare) , networking, storage, and associated enterprise services. The role requires strong analytical and problem-solving skills, effective project coordination, excellent time management, and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment. Success in this position depends on broad interdisciplinary technical knowledge spanning infrastructure, cloud services, operating systems, security, networking, databases, and enterprise applications, as well as the ability to quickly learn new technologies and adapt to evolving business and technical requirements. The Engineer works closely with cross-functional teams, vendors, and business stakeholders to deliver reliable infrastructure services, support strategic projects, and drive continuous improvement while maintaining operational excellence and compliance with corporate standards. Design, implement, operate, and continuously improve cloud and hybrid infrastructure platforms with a primary focus on Microsoft Azure and Google Cloud Platform (GCP), ensuring security, scalability, resilience, and cost efficiency. Provision, automate, and manage infrastructure using Terraform, GitHub, and GitHub Actions following Infrastructure as Code and DevOps best practices. Support and optimize cloud & on-prem services including compute, storage, networking, identity, monitoring, backup, disaster recovery, and cost management. Administer Windows and Linux server environments, ensuring availability, performance, compliance, patching, and lifecycle management. Support virtualization, enterprise storage, and hybrid cloud environments, including performance optimization, backup, recovery, and infrastructure modernization. Monitor platform health, troubleshoot complex technical issues, perform root cause analysis, and implement permanent corrective actions. Collaborate with global infrastructure teams, architects, vendors, and business stakeholders to deliver cloud migrations, platform enhancements, and operational improvements. Maintain technical documentation, operational procedures, architecture standards, and support runbooks. Participate in incident, change, problem, security, and compliance management processes and act as an escalation point for technical support teams. YOUR TALENT: Strong experience designing, implementing, and operating Microsoft Azure enterprise environments, including governance, security, networking, monitoring, and hybrid cloud integration. Experience with Google Cloud Platform (GCP) administration and operations. Hands-on experience with Terraform, GitHub, GitHub Actions, and Infrastructure as Code methodologies. Solid administration experience with Windows Server, Linux, Active Directory, and Microsoft Entra ID. Experience supporting VMware or comparable virtualization platforms, including clustering, high availability, and disaster recovery. Experience with enterprise storage, backup, recovery, and data lifecycle management. Working knowledge of Microsoft SQL Server infrastructure, including backup, recovery, monitoring, and performance optimization. Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills across cloud & on-prem, infrastructure, networking, storage, and virtualization technologies. Experience with PowerShell or similar scripting and automation tools. Ability to optimize infrastructure reliability, performance, and cost efficiency. Strong communication, collaboration, and documentation skills. Ability to work independently within a global infrastructure organization. Experience with Azure governance and landing zone concepts, including RBAC, Azure Policy, tagging, and cost management. Experience with Jira and Confluence. Knowledge of Azure networking, hybrid connectivity, and cloud security best practices. Exposure to container platforms such as AKS, GKE, or other cloud-native technologies. Experience using Microsoft Copilot or other AI-assisted operational tools. Microsoft Azure certifications (AZ-104, AZ-305) and/or Google Cloud certifications. Industry certifications demonstrating continuous professional development. The hiring range base pay for this position is $67,700 - $91,900 + Bonus + Benefits . (Benefit Summary Corporate) Pay may vary depending on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience.
